# RichRepo

A demo agent that uses 0G Storage and 0G Compute.

## Setup

To get started, run `npm install`.

## Architecture

![architecture diagram](docs/architecture.png)

## Demo

Watch the demo: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=abc123def

[Live demo](https://richrepo.vercel.app)

## Tracks

This project is submitted to the framework track.

## iNFT

Includes an iNFT (ERC-7857) implementation. Contract: 0x1234567890abcdef1234567890abcdef12345678

## Contact

Telegram: @richdev

Team: see CONTRIBUTORS.md
